fact: The World Bank says the Takaful and Karama Program runs a social registry that includes all applicants since inception and has reached around 11.3 million registered households (40.5 million individuals).

The World Bank says Takaful and Karama (two components) and the FORSA, Two is enough, Waii and 1,000 days cash-plus interventions are designed on, or target beneficiaries from, the TKP social registry.
The national social registry holds data on 13 million households, about half of Egypt's, per the Ministry of Social Solidarity's Raafat Shafik.
The social registry is linked to 27 government databases through the national ID number, per Raafat Shafik of the Ministry of Social Solidarity.
